name: purpose
title: Purpose
description: Why the organisation exists: what its people believe in, what it aims to achieve, and the goals it is working toward.

files.props.yaml:
# THE PURPOSE DOCUMENT'S OWN FIELDS: every brief is the writer's instruction; the org's answers live in its pack.
statement:
  type: string
  input: true
  description: >-
    Why the enterprise exists, in its own words: the purpose or mission statement it
    publishes, quoted where one exists. When it publishes none, one sentence composed only
    from what its about page says it is for. Never a marketing slogan.
  maxLength: 400
values:
  type: array
  input: true
  description: >-
    What the people of the enterprise believe in and consider valuable: the values it
    publishes, each with its name as the enterprise writes it and the one sentence it
    gives for it. From the values, culture or about pages. Empty when none are published;
    never invented.
  maxItems: 8
  items:
    name:
      type: string
      description: >-
        The name as the organisation writes it.
      maxLength: 80
    what:
      type: string
      description: >-
        One sentence, in the organisation's words.
      maxLength: 240
ambition:
  type: string
  input: true
  description: >-
    The far end of the purpose: what the enterprise says it aims to achieve for its
    customers, its country or society, in one paragraph, quoted where a vision or ambition
    statement exists, with the horizon it names. Not the goals below; the outcome they
    serve.
  maxLength: 700
goals:
  type: array
  input: true
  description: >-
    The goal tree: the strategic goals, pillars or commitments the enterprise names (a
    strategy page, a strategy section of the annual report, 'our commitments'). One entry
    per goal with its name as the enterprise writes it and one sentence on why, nested in
    `goals` where it nests them. Empty when none are named; never invented.
  maxItems: 12
  items:
    name:
      type: string
      description: >-
        The name as the organisation writes it.
      maxLength: 80
    why:
      type: string
      description: >-
        One sentence on why, in the organisation's words.
      maxLength: 240
    goals:
      type: array
      description: >-
        The nested goals, in the same shape, where the organisation nests them.
whenToUse:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: >-
    When an agent should reach for this document, from the side of whoever is asking. Assigned from
    the object's manifest.
files.purpose.yaml:
unoverse: "1.0"
# The org's purpose document (docs/unoverse/data/objects/elements/purpose.md). The document in the pack
# (design/<org>/identity/purpose.yaml) is the truth; this row is its presence, positioned like
# everything else so an agent finds it the way it finds a product. One per org: uniqueBy says so.
# A document has no call to action, so it embeds on five of the base's six.
type: object
name: purpose
element: purpose
# THE GLYPH its rows are drawn with (README 4a): a lucide icon name.
icon: compass
# NEVER A ROW (owner, 2026-09-14): the shape of an identity document, like organisation. An
# agent reads it through {{identity.<document>}} and the prompt blocks, never by search, so it
# extends nothing and declares no embed: it has no place on the map.

# THE FACE, as a node's node.yaml carries it: what this is and when an Agent reaches for it.
title: Purpose
description: >-
  Why the organisation exists: what its people believe in, what it aims to achieve, and the
  goals it is working toward.
whenToUse: >-
  Answer why the organisation exists, what its people believe in, what it aims to achieve
  and the goals it is working toward. Beliefs and intent, stated in the present: the
  ambition itself and the reasons behind it.
category: Identity
version: 1.0.0
